The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: to hold something while moving.

draft.shortGloss: to carry; to transport; to move
notes: While 運ぶ can mean 'to transport' (like a truck carrying goods), it is also used for simply carrying an object in your hands while walking.
Do not confuse this with 持つ (motsu), which just means 'to hold' or 'to possess' and does not necessarily imply movement from one location to another.

senses.definition: To hold something while moving it from one place to another.

examples.emotion: strained and focused, exerting effort to move something heavy

senses.definition: To move something or someone by vehicle or system over a distance.
